description: A Streamlit data dashboard in Python that turns data into interactive charts and tables.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a data dashboard with charts and sidebar filters
ui.description: Streamlit dashboard — Python 3.11, port 5000. Timeout ingress (no rewrite). For data apps with widgets, charts, and tables.

sample_prompts: Build a CSV upload dashboard that shows summary statistics and charts
Create a real-time metric tracker with line charts and sidebar filters
Make an interactive data explorer that lets users filter and sort a sample dataset
kit_prompt_prefix: Build a Streamlit data dashboard app.
